forum.title: Driver stm32_pmic2 on node stpmic2@33 failed - TEE_ERROR_ITEM_NOT_FOUND
forum.category: STM32 MPUs Embedded software and solutions
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @Olivier GALLIEN

Here is the answer: The problem was that the interrupt was not enabled for PMIC inside the DT!

Once the interrupt GPIO was correct, then the error disapear.
forum.author: DMårt
